clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Burning Blade Coven, Vile Familiar Heads mark a grim test for young Horde warlocks. Under Ruzan's guidance, they gather the gruesome trophies as proof of readiness to bind their first demonic minions. The test demands discipline and respect for the lethality of the beings they mean to summon.

In the sun-baked canyon of the Valley of Trials, Ruzan asks novices seeking to learn summoning to bring him six Vile Familiar Heads. Vile familiars are fiery imps with dangerous elemental cunning, found outside the Burning Blade Coven. Novices must face and defeat them, proving they can subdue demonic life rather than be overcome by it. Warlocks are barely tolerated within Thrall's Horde, so their training calls for care. A novice slain by a conjured creature only deepens the dishonor and suspicion cast upon practitioners of the dark arts.
